segments.name: Cirrus Logic, Inc.
segments.description: Designer of low-power, high-precision mixed-signal processing solutions for smartphones, PCs, tablets, wearables, and automotive applications.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and tracks its results in one reportable segment, but reports revenue performance in two product lines: Audio and HPMS.

revenueModel.text: Electronics manufacturers purchase audio and high-performance mixed-signal processing components directly, through distributors, or via contract manufacturers.
revenueModel.evidence: These end customers may then purchase our products directly from us, through distributors, or indirectly from third-party manufacturers contracted to produce their designs.
